_notes: Single model family available today (per 2026-09-17 design conversation): claude-sonnet-5.
Originally scoped around a private 'fable' model; superseded -- model identity now lives here, not hardcoded in review_cli.py, so it can be repointed without touching code.

'effort' is a reasoning-effort/tier label, not a distinct model family -- it is how lane/budget-tier stakes get expressed with only one model available (see design conversation: 09/10 keep the strongest tier regardless of budget; probe-budget lanes run cheaper/faster).

Quorum panels (design-v3.md Sec5) additionally use 'personas' (see quorum_personas below) since real model-family diversity isn't available yet -- every quorum result must still be tagged diversity_requirement_met:false downstream.

quorum_personas._note: Used only for lanes running an evidence-qualified quorum panel (currently 09). 2 personas for WARRANTED-tier votes, 3 for malfeasance/NO-GO/RE-DAST-escalation tier, per design-v3.md Sec5.1.

invocation.status: PROVISIONAL -- the claude binary reachable from the Cowork device-bridge sandbox only supports bare `claude -p "<prompt>"`, no --model/--effort/other flags. This template assumes that restricted shape (prompt text only, no flag pass-through) until confirmed against the real WSL/terminal environment the harness will actually run in. If a fuller Claude Code CLI (or the fable endpoint, later) is available there with real --model/--effort flags, update command_template and this status field -- do not assume the sandboxed binary's limits apply to the real run environment.
